title: DigitalHumanities MuseumProvenanceMerge

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the Digital Humanities Museum Provenance Merge research task. Merged museum_export_a.csv and museum_export_b.csv into a deduplicated catalog with 1 unique object. Implemented schema mapping, accession number normalization, duplicate detection, and temporal information extraction from unstructured text. Generated temporal distribution analysis with visualizations and produced a comprehensive research report (report/report.md) with methodology, results, and discussion. All deliverables created: deduplicated catalog, catalog with extracted years, century distribution statistics, three visualization plots, and complete analysis code.
